**Abraham Lugo** is a former Hot Wheels and [Matchbox](/wiki/Matchbox) designer who has been with Mattel from 2008 to 2025. Prior to joining Mattel, he was a designer at Jakks Pacific. Lugo was part of the Hot Wheels design team from 2008 through 2011 and subsequently joined the Matchbox design team; he departed the company in 2025.
